support_reconstruction: identical to the frozen leave-one-cell-out diagnostic: same 63 joint support cells, same 100m thinning/matching, both 2008 lineages required, same consensus and independent plane refits

analysis.pairs: all unordered pairs of distinct joint support cells; for n=63 this is exactly 1953 runs
analysis.for_each_pair: remove exactly the two cells, refit both independent planes on remaining 61 points, recompute Pearson, Spearman, sign concordance and RMSE

diagnostic_labels.TWO_CELL_SENSITIVE: at least one pair passes the original three-metric gate
diagnostic_labels.DISTRIBUTED_BEYOND_TWO_CELLS: no pair passes the original three-metric gate
